correctness.rationale: For arbitrary ecological parameters satisfying u0>0 and A<C, the exact periodized Gaussian Fourier multiplier is e^{-sigma k^2}. Scalar f_D(z)=A-C exp(-sigma z)-Dz is strictly concave, negative at z=0 and at infinity, and has at most two positive roots. Its unique critical maximum gives Dc=sigma C[-q/W_{-1}(-q/e)]. Every unstable Fourier mode belongs to a complete ordered family of L-intervals; the j/(j+1) gap condition is exactly j<kminus/(kplus-kminus), proving the integer count. Taylor expansion at the nondegenerate double zero proves N(D)=sqrt(sigma Dc zc/[2(Dc-D)])+O(1). The exact rational example verifies both roots k=3,4 and strict positivity at k^2=10; strict concavity excludes other roots. Standard-library checker replay supplements, and does not replace, each infinite proof step.
